WITH account_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.account_id,
        d.A3 as region,
        COUNT(*) as order_count
    FROM "order" o
    JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
),
overall_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(order_count) as overall_avg
    FROM account_orders
),
account_differences AS (
    SELECT 
        ao.account_id,
        ao.region,
        ao.order_count,
        ao.order_count - os.overall_avg as diff_from_overall,
        os.overall_avg
    FROM account_orders ao
    CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
),
region_avg_differences AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        AVG(diff_from_overall) as region_avg_diff
    FROM account_differences
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
    ad.account_id,
    ad.region,
    ad.order_count,
    ad.diff_from_overall,
    ad.diff_from_overall - rad.region_avg_diff as exceeds_region_avg
FROM account_differences ad
JOIN region_avg_differences rad ON ad.region = rad.region
WHERE ad.diff_from_overall > rad.region_avg_diff
ORDER BY exceeds_region_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
